_comment: Internet radio stations for the head unit, shown as a grid of tiles, six
`name` is what appears under the focused tile, so keep it short: the panel
is 320x230 and a long name is truncated with an ellipsis.
Artwork, best source first: a file bundled in audio/logos/<slug>.<ext>,
which needs no network and cannot change under the car; then `logo_url`;
then the best icon `site` advertises. Guessed artwork lands on a
station's favicon as often as its mark, so give one of the first two
wherever a good logo is known. Fetched and cached by
`tile` is the two or three characters drawn when there is no artwork at
all, and `color` is the square behind the logo, which shows around a mark
Prefer plain MP3 or AAC stream URLs over .pls or .m3u wrappers where the
station offers both: MPD follows a wrapper, but that is one more fetch
before any sound, and pulling away from a signal is when it fails.
Edit on the Pi at /var/lib/comand/stations.json; the bridge re-reads it
when it changes, so no restart is needed.
